{{alias}}( f, a, b, n )

Computes the numerical integral of a function using Simpson's rule.

Parameters
----------
f: Function
    Function to integrate.
a: number
    Lower bound of integration.
b: number
    Upper bound of integration.
n: number
    Number of intervals (must be a positive even integer).

Returns
-------
y: number
    Approximate value of the definite integral.

Examples
--------
> var y = {{alias}}( function(x){ return x*x; }, 0.0, 1.0, 100 )
~0.3333

> y = {{alias}}( Math.sin, 0.0, {{alias:@stdlib/constants/float64/pi}}, 100 )
~2.0

--------
